book.name: Yoan
book.title: Varu poia to Yoan imbooda Jon—John

content: Yesu lolo isamin liva eez to ighur maat
Yesu ipul Yerusalem, ve izala pa lolooz Oliv, ve ineep tonowe pa mboŋ.
Mboŋmaagh kat, ve ye imuul ila, ve ilooŋ ila sirsiir to Rumai Tiina. Ve ival tiina tinim tiluvuti. Tovenen ye mbole izi, ve ipatoot di pa Maaron aliŋa.

Ye isavsaav padi, ve yes ŋgara to tutuuŋ toman ndiran tutuuŋa pida tigham liva eez, ve tila tivot toni. Liva tonowen ighur maat, ve tamtoghon pida tighita. Tauto tikisi, ve tighami tila to Yesu. Ghoro tipayoonda ila ival tiina matadi, ve tisaav pa Yesu tighaze: “Patoŋaaŋ, ughita liva tonene. Ye ighur maat, ve tamtoghon pida tighita.
Mose ighur tutuuŋ ariaŋa pait ighaze liva tovene, iit irau tarabi pa yaam le imaat. Ve yom usaav vena?” Wkp 20:10; Lo 22:22+

Yes tisavia saveeŋ tonene pa titoova. Ighaze ye isavia saveeŋ eta isosor, ghoro inim le pughu pa tipayoonda pa savsaveeŋ. Eemoghon Yesu ipamuul aliŋadi rikia maau. Izi imbutur, ve imbodbood ila taan pa nima u.
Yes tinoknok ghasoniiŋi. Tovenen mata iza, ve isaav padi tovene: “Tiam eta, ighaze le sosor eta maau, ghoro igham yaam ve irab liva tonene muuŋ.” Mt 7:1+; Ro 2:1,22
Ghoro mata izi muul, ve imbodbood pa nima u ila taan.
Yes tilooŋ saveeŋ toni, ve eŋaeŋa tipaspas ve tiwaghaughau. Ndolman timuuŋ, ve yes papaghudi titaghon di, ve tisob tighau tila. Tovenen liva tonenen eŋgeni moghon iyondyood ila Yesu nagho.
Yesu imundig iyoon, ve ighasoni ighaze: “Liva, yes to tigham ghom unum ne, tila vena? Eta ineep pa ighur atia payom maau?”

Liva tonenen ipamuul aliŋa ighaze: “Tiina, eta ineep sualen muul maau. Tisob tighau tila wa.” Yesu isaav pani muul: “Ighaze venen, you paam irau naghur atia payom maau. Ula. Eemoghon matam iŋgal. Muri, ugham sosor muul malep.” Yo 3:17, 5:14
Yesu inim ghazooŋa to taan

Yesu isaav ila pa ival tiina muul ighaze: “You taug to ghazooŋa to taan. Ighaze tamtoghon eta itaghon ghou, ye pale ilaagh ila ndoroom lolo muul maau. Ghazooŋa to Maaron pale ineep toni, ve igham nepooŋ poia inim tiou.” Mbo 27:1; Is 49:6; Lu 2:32; Yo 1:4+; 2Kor 4:6
Yesu ipariaaŋ tamtoghon pa tighur ila saveeŋ toni

Ndiran tutuuŋa tilooŋ saveeŋ tonene, ve tisaav pani tighaze: “Ughita. Aazne, yom usavia taum, ve upariaaŋ taum saveeŋ tiom leso tamtoghon tighur ilat tiom. Eemoghon lem mbeb eta to ipariaaŋ saveeŋ tiom leso nighur ila ne maau. Saveeŋ tovene, pale nighur ila vena?”

Yesu ipamuul aliŋadi ighaze: “Onoon, you nasavia taug ve napariaaŋ taug saveeŋ tiou, leso tamtoghon tighur inim tiou. Ve saveeŋ tiou, nene onoon. Yam irau aghur ila. Pasa, ndug to nanim pani ve muri pale namuul nala pani, you nawatagi. Eemoghon yam awatag ndug tonowen maau. Yo 5:31+, 7:28+, 9:29
Gabizooŋ tiam, nene itaghon ŋgar to tamtoghon. Eemoghon you naŋgabiiz tamtoghon nanimale yam maau.
Ve ighaze naŋgabiiz tamtoghon eta, nene pale gabizooŋ tiou deŋia. Pasa, eŋgengou naŋgabiiz tamtoghon eta maau. Tamaŋ to imbaaŋ ghou nanim, yeru nilup ghei pa uraat tonenen.

Saveeŋ waaro eez to ineep ila tutuuŋ tiam paam isaav tovene: ‘Ighaze tamtoghon ru tipariaaŋ saveeŋ eta, ve tisavia saveeŋ raraate, nene irau taghur ila taghaze saveeŋ tonenen, nene onoon.’ Lo 19:15; Mt 18:16
Aazne, you taug napariaaŋ saveeŋ tiou. Eemoghon Tamaŋ to imbaaŋ ghou nanim, ye paam ipariaaŋ saveeŋ tiou. Tovenen yam irau aghur ila.” 1Yo 5:9
Tauto tighasoni tighaze: “Tamam ineep sine?” Yesu ipamuul aliŋadi ighaze: “Yam awatag ghou maau. Tauto awatag Tamaŋ maau. Ve inimale awatag ghou, tone awatag Tamaŋ paam.” Yo 14:7; 1Yo 2:23
Yesu ipatoot tamtoghon pa Maaron aliŋa izi ndug to tipipiyaav yaam pa uraat to Rumai Tiina, ve isavia saveeŋ tonene. Eemoghon tamtoghon eta ikisi maau. Pasa, sawa toni ivot sone.
Ighaze taghur ila to Yesu maau, nene pale tamaat toman sosor toit ve talaleed

Yesu isaav padi muul ighaze: “You pale napul gham ve nala, ve yam akaal ghou. Eemoghon irau aghita ghou maau. Pasa, ndug to you pale nala pani, nene yam irau ala pani maau. Tovenen yam pale amatmaat toman sosor tiam ve alalemim.” Yo 7:34, 13:33

Daba to yes Yuda tilooŋ saveeŋ tonene, ve tiwaghasonin di tighaze: “Wai, ye isaav ighaze ndug to ye pale ila pani, nene iit irau tala pani maau. Saveeŋ toni tonene, pughu vena? Ma ye ighaze ila irab tau imaat?”
Yesu isaav padi muul ighaze: “Alooŋ. Yam to sila. Ve you to sala. Yam to taan, tauto ataghon ŋgar to taan. Ve you to taan maau. Yo 3:31
Pughu tonene to nasaav payam naghaze yam pale amatmaat toman sosor tiam ve alalemim. Pasa, yam irau aghur ila aghaze Ŋgeu to iza YOU NANEPNEEP, nene you taug tonene.
Ve ighaze aghur inim tiou maau, yam pale amatmaat toman sosor tiam, ve alalemim.” Igham 3:14; Yo 3:18
Yes tilooŋ saveeŋ tonene, ve tighasoni muul tighaze: “Yom sei? Usavia taum kat.” Yesu ipamuul aliŋadi ighaze: “Sawa to napamundigin uraat tiou ve inim, you navovotia taug payam.

You naghita ŋgar tiam naol isosor. Tovenen leg saveeŋ naol to nasavia payam, ve you irau naghur atia payam. Eemoghon you irau nagham tovene maau. Pasa, Ŋgeu to imbaaŋ ghou nanim, ye avo onoon. Ve saveeŋ to naloŋlooŋa ila toni, tauto navovotia pa yam tamtoghon to taan.”
Saveeŋ tonene, ye isavia iŋarua Tama Maaron. Eemoghon yes tighilaal saveeŋ toni pughu maau.
Tovenen Yesu iseeŋ saveeŋ toni muul ighaze: “Sawa to yam apayoon Tamtoghon Natu iza,

nene pale ŋgar tiam ivot, ve aghilaal aghaze: You to izag Nanepneep. Ve awatag aghaze you nagham mbeb eta itaghon taug ŋgar tiou maau. Saveeŋ to nalooŋa ila to Tamaŋ, tauto navovotia pa tamtoghon. Yo 5:30, 12:32, 14:24
Ŋgeu to imbaaŋ ghou nanim, ye irau ipul ghou maau. Ye inepneep toman ghou. Pasa sawa isob, you nataghon ŋgar to ye lolo pani.”
Yesu isavia saveeŋ tonene, ve tamtoghon katindi to tiloŋlooŋa, tighur ila toni.
Saveeŋ onoon irau ipas ghiit tavot pa samia tapiri
Ghoro Yesu isaav pa Yuda pida to tighur ila toni ne tovene: “Ighaze akis saveeŋ tiou tuŋia ve ataghoni, nene pale anim taghoniiŋa tiou kat.
Ve yam pale awatag katin saveeŋ onoon, ve saveeŋ tonowen ipas gham avot pa samia tapiri. Leso anim mbesooŋa sorok muul sob.” Ro 6:18, 8:2; Ga 5:1

Yes tipamuul aliŋa tighaze: “Wai, yei tonene Abaram papaghu toni. Yei ninim mbesooŋa sorok pa tamtoghon eta pa eta sone. Pughu vena to yom usaav ughaze yei pale ninim mbesooŋa sorok muul maau?” Lu 3:8+

Yesu ipamuul ghasoniiŋ todi ighaze: “Onoon kat, you nasaav payam. Tamtoghon tisob to tinoknok ghamuuŋ ŋgar samia, nene tinim mbesooŋa sorok pa ŋgar samia. Pasa, ŋgar tonowen to ighamgham pooz padi. Ro 6:16+; 2Pe 2:19
Mbesooŋa eta irau ineep toman ruum tama itaghoni taghoni gha ila ne maau. Natu moghon to ineep tomani irau sawa isob. Mbnp 21:10; Ga 4:30
Tovenen ighaze Maaron Natu ipas gham avot pa samia tapiri, ye pale ipas gham kat. Leso samia iŋgin gham muul sob. Hib 2:14+; 1Yo 3:6,9
Onoon, yam papaghu to Abaram. Eemoghon saveeŋ tiou le ina eta to ineep ila lolomim maau. Tauto aazne, azuaria gham aghaze le arab ghou namaat.
Mbeb to yeru Tamaŋ nineep ve naghita, tauto nasavia payam. Ve yam tovene paam. Ŋgar to yam aloŋlooŋa ila to tamamim, tauto aghamghami.”
Sa ndiran to Abaram papaghu toni kat?
Yes tipamuul aliŋa tighaze: “Yei timbumai to Abaram.” Tovenen Yesu isaav padi ighaze: “Inimale yam Abaram papaghu toni kat, tone ataghon ŋgar to muuŋ ye ighamghami. Ro 2:28; Ga 3:7,29
Eemoghon maau. Aghita. Aazne, you navotia saveeŋ onoon to nalooŋa ila to Tamaŋ Maaron ne payam. Eemoghon ŋgar tiam iyaryaaŋ aghaze le arab ghou namaat. Abaram, ye igham ŋgar tovene maau.
Nene yam ataghon tamamim ŋgar toni.” Yes tipamuul aliŋa tighaze: “Yei Abaram papaghu toni kat. Ve Tamamai ee moghon kat, to Maaron. Nditinamai tipoop ghei sorok maau.”

Yesu ipamuul aliŋadi ighaze: “Inimale yam Maaron ndinatu kat, tone lolomim payou. Pasa, you naneep toni to nanim. You nataghon taug lolog ve nanim maau. Ye imbaaŋ ghou, tauto nanim. Yo 16:27+; 1Yo 5:1
Pughu vena to aghazooŋ pa saveeŋ tiou sone? Yam avaat apoon lolomim wa. Tauto irau alooŋ saveeŋ tiou maau. Ro 8:7; 1Kor 2:14

Alooŋ wa! Yam tamamim to Sadan! Tauto aghaze le ataghon katin ŋgar to ye lolo pani. Sawa to muuŋ kat ve inim, ye ŋgeu to rabuuŋ tamtoghon timatmaat. Ve ye itaghon saveeŋ onoon maau. Pasa, saveeŋ onoon eta ineep toni maau. Ye kaarom taamdi. Sawa isob, isasavia saveeŋ kaarom to inepneep ila lolo. Ve ye to inim pughu pa saveeŋ kaarom to naol ne. Mbnp 3:1+; 1Yo 3:8
Saveeŋ isob to you nasasavia payam, nene onoon moghon. Eemoghon yam lolomim pa saveeŋ onoon maau, tauto aghur ila saveeŋ tiou maau.

Ma vena? Ighaze tiam eta ighita ghou nagham sosor eta, ghoro ivotia lak! Ve ighaze leg sosor eta maau, ve nasasavia saveeŋ onoon moghon payam, pughu vena to aghur ila saveeŋ tiou maau? Hib 4:15; 1Pe 2:22; 1Yo 3:5
Sei to ighaze inim Maaron le, nene iloŋlooŋ Maaron aliŋa ve itaghoni. Eemoghon yam tamtoghon to Maaron maau. Tauto alooŋ aliŋa maau.” Yo 10:26+, 18:37; 1Yo 4:6
Sawa to Abaram ivot sone, Yesu ineep wa
Yesu isavia saveeŋ tonene, ve yes Yuda tisaav pani tighaze: “Wai, saveeŋ tauto nisavia ila wa. Yom ukankaan pa Maaron unumale yes Samaria. Yom, avuvu samia izeev ghom!” Mk 3:21+; Yo 7:20, 10:20
Yesu ipamuul aliŋadi ighaze: “You, avuvu samia eta izeev ghou maau. You nazuaria ghou pa paitooŋ Tamaŋ Maaron iza. Eemoghon yam aveleg ghou.
You nagham pa taug izag maau. Eemoghon Ŋgeu eez izuaria tau ighaze igham izag inim tiina, nene Tamaŋ Maaron. Ve uraat to gabizooŋ mbeb ve ghuruuŋ atia, nene ineep ila ye tau nima. Yo 5:41, 7:18
Onoon kat, you nasaav payam: Ighaze tamtoghon eta mata kisin saveeŋ tiou ve itaghoni, ye irau imaat ve ilale ne maau. Maau kat.” Yo 5:24, 11:26

Yes tilooŋ saveeŋ tonene, ve tisaav pani tighaze: “Aa, ŋgaramus niwatag katin ghom. Yom tonene, avuvu samia izeev ghom! Pasa, Abaram toman propeta tisob timataar tila wa. Eemoghon yom usaav tovene: Ighaze tamtoghon eta mata kisin saveeŋ tiom ve itaghoni, ye irau imaat ve ilale ne maau.
Timbumai Abaram, ye imaat wa. Ve yes propeta paam timataar wa. Yom sa ŋgeu? Yom ughaze ulib pa Abaram? Usavia taum kat!”

Yesu isaav padi: “Ighaze napait taug izag, nene pale saveeŋ tiou ighur maau. Paitooŋ tovene, nene mbeb sorok. Eemoghon Tamaŋ to yam awatwaata aghaze Maaron tiam, ye tau to ipait ghou ve igham izag inim tiina.
Yam awatagi rita maau. Eemoghon you, ghoro nawatagi. Tauto naloŋlooŋ aliŋa, ve nataghoni. Ighaze nasaav naghaze nawatagi maau, nene pale nagham kaarom nanimale yam.
Muuŋ, timbumim Abaram ighita sawa tiou to navot izi taan. Ye iwatag mbeb to pale ivot pa sawa tonene, tauto tini iza ve lolo poia kat.”
Tovenen yes Yuda tonenen tipamuul Yesu aliŋa tighaze: “Wai, ndaman tiom tamoot ru saaŋgul (50) sone. Ve yom upakur taum ughaze ughita Abaram!”
Yesu isaav padi muul ighaze: “Onoon kat, you nasaav payam: Abaram ivot sone, ve You Nanepneep.” Igham 3:14; Yo 1:1; Kol 1:17; Syg 1:8
Saveeŋ toni tonene ireu yes Yuda tonenen lolodi. Tovenen tikor yaam tighaze tirabi pataghaaŋ. Eemoghon ye iŋguaaz tau, ve ipul Rumai Tiina, ve ivot ila pumuri.

footnotes.text: Uwaat Maaron Igham Mulin Yes Israela (= Kisim Bek o Eksodus) 3:14. Maaron iza Yoova (o Yahweh), pughu tovene ‘You nanepneep.’ Tovenen saveeŋ waaro tonene, pughu tovene: Iit irau taghur ila to Yesu taghaze ye Maaron.
Saveeŋ waaro tonene, Yesu isavia sawa to tirabi ila ai pambarooŋ ve tipayoonda imonau. Sawa tonenen ve ila, Yesu iza tiina pale ineep ghazooŋa.
Ŋgara pida tighaze Maaron ivotia mbeb to muri Mesia pale ighami pa Abaram ila vibiiŋ.
